# WaveformChart

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Scrolling multi-trace chart fed with binary samples (CHART-001 .. CHART-009).

![WaveformChart, light theme](../img/widgets/waveform-chart-light.png#only-light){ width="488" }
![WaveformChart, dark theme](../img/widgets/waveform-chart-dark.png#only-dark){ width="488" }

**Graphs, time** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments_industrial.WaveformChart) ·
schema [`waveformchart.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.WaveformChart(
    label="WaveformChart",
    history=400,
    n_traces=2,
    y_min=-1.5,
    y_max=1.5,
    dt=0.01,
    x_unit="s",
    unit="V",
    traces=[{"name": "sin"}, {"name": "noisy cos"}],
    cursors=[{"x": 4.2, "name": "C1", "color": ""}],
    annotations=[{"x": 3, "y": 1.2, "text": "note", "color": ""}],
    size=(480, 220),
)
```

The data of the picture (samples, history or drawing) is sent with the widget's methods,
not as traits: see the [widget catalog](../widgets.md).

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | array of any | `[]` | host | Latest sample of each trace, written by the host with each append. |
| `history` | integer | `1024` | host | Points kept and shown per trace. |
| `n_traces` | integer | `1` | host |  |
| `update_mode` | `"strip"`, `"scope"`, `"sweep"` | `"strip"` | host | strip: continuous scroll; scope: fill then restart; sweep: a moving cursor overwrites the oldest data. |
| `y_min` | number | `-1` | host, widget | Y range when autoscale_y is off; set by the operator with the axes panel. |
| `y_max` | number | `1` | host, widget |  |
| `autoscale_y` | boolean | `false` | host, widget |  |
| `y_scale` | `"linear"`, `"log"` | `"linear"` | host | Scale of the left Y axis; on a logarithmic axis values <= 0 are not drawn, and a range reaching 0 or below starts at y_max / 1000 (IND-117). |
| `y2_min` | number | `0` | host | Range of the secondary axis on the right, for the traces with axis right, when autoscale_y2 is off (IND-117). |
| `y2_max` | number | `1` | host |  |
| `autoscale_y2` | boolean | `false` | host |  |
| `y2_unit` | string | `""` | host | Unit of the secondary axis, shown under it and after the values of its traces under a cursor. |
| `paused` | boolean | `false` | host | Freeze the display; samples keep arriving (CHART-009). |
| `dt` | number | `1` | host | Sample interval in x-axis units; 0 is shown as 1. |
| `traces` | array of object | `[]` | host | Optional style of each trace {name, color, width, visible, axis}. |
| `show_legend` | boolean | `true` | host |  |
